--[[
	InventoryLayout  -  the Inventory panel. Classic builds the original panel (InventoryPanel). The
	other theme modes build one panel: a title bar with the Library / Local switch, the lists as
	tabs across the top, an image-only tile grid, and along the bottom a round filter button, the
	search bar and (local lists) a round add button. The multi-select strip and the details of
	the selected tile dock between the grid and that bottom row.
	  InventoryLayout.build(screenGui) -> refs
	Refs keep the names InventoryWiring reads in both cases. refs.InvSkin exists only outside
	Classic: the wiring creates tiles, list tabs, menu options and tab states through it, so their
	geometry lives here (Metrics, Skin) and the wiring keeps its own numbers for Classic alone.
	refs.InvHome is the panel's place after Reset Layout.

local C = require(script.Parent.Constants)

local InventoryLayout = {}

local function buildModern(screenGui)
	local metrics = Metrics.get()
	local pad = LAYOUT.PanelPad
	local slot = LAYOUT.IconSlot
	local refs = {}
	local skin = Skin.new(metrics)
	refs.InvSkin = skin

	-- Wide and tall enough for Columns x Rows tiles: a tile's gap to its right neighbour covers
	-- the ring room and the scrollbar of the last column.
	local cell = metrics.Tile + metrics.TileGap + metrics.TileName
	local width = metrics.Columns * (metrics.Tile + metrics.TileGap) + pad * 2
	local gridTop = LAYOUT.TitleBar + metrics.TabRow + GAP
	local height = gridTop + metrics.Rows * cell + GAP + LAYOUT.Search + pad * 2

	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.Name = "InventoryPanel"
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = T.PanelBg
	panel.BackgroundTransparency = T.PanelAlpha
	panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -width / 2, 0.08, 0)
	panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, height)
	panel.ClipsDescendants = true
	panel.Active = true
	panel.Visible = false
	panel.Parent = screenGui
	W.addCorner(panel, T.BigCorner)
	W.addStroke(panel)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().panels, panel)
	W.attachPanelBackground(panel)
	W.makeResizable(panel, metrics.MinWidth, metrics.MinHeight)
	-- Its grid scrolls, so it gives way to a panel opened over it (PanelPush).
	W.allowPush(panel, metrics.MinWidth, metrics.MinHeight)
	refs.InventoryPanel = panel
	refs.InvHome = panel.Position

	-- Whole-panel scale, set by the Size slider of the title bar's menu.
	local panelScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	panelScale.Name = "PanelScale"
	panelScale.Parent = panel
	refs.InvScale = panelScale

	-- Everything but the tooltip and the dialogs sits inside the panel padding. The panel has no
	-- UIPadding of its own, so what the wiring places from the panel's corner needs no offset.
	local content = Instance.new("Frame")
	content.Name = "Content"
	content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	content.Position = UDim2.new(0, pad, 0, pad)
	content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -pad * 2, 1, -pad * 2)
	content.Parent = panel

	local bar = W.makeTitleBar(content, "Inventory", 0)
	bar.title.Size = UDim2.new(0, metrics.Title, 1, 0)
	-- Its menu drops over the tabs and the grid.
	bar.header.Parent.ZIndex = 10
	refs.InventoryClose = bar.close
	W.makeDraggable(panel, bar.dragHandle)
	local closeMore = buildMoreMenu(bar, refs, metrics)

	-- Two segmented strips Skin.buildLists fills: the Library / Local switch and the list tabs.
	local groupSwitch = W.makeSegmentStrip(bar.header, "Groups")
	groupSwitch.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
	groupSwitch.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	groupSwitch.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(slot * 2 + GAP), 0.5, 0)
	groupSwitch.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, LAYOUT.TitleBar - 8)
	groupSwitch.ZIndex = 3

	local listTabs = W.makeSegmentStrip(content, "Lists")
	listTabs.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, LAYOUT.TitleBar)
	listTabs.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, metrics.TabRow)
	skin.setListHosts(groupSwitch, listTabs)

	local grid = buildGrid(content, refs, gridTop)
	buildTooltip(panel, refs)
	local _, setTabsShown, closeAdd = BottomRow.build(content, refs, metrics, skin)
	local selection = Bars.buildSelection(content, metrics)
	skin.selection = selection
	local detail = Bars.buildDetail(content, refs, metrics)

	-- From the bottom up: the bottom row, the details card, the multi-select strip; the grid
	-- takes what is left.
	local function layoutBody()
		local docked = LAYOUT.Search + GAP
		detail.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -docked)
		if detail.Visible then
			docked += Bars.detailHeight(metrics) + GAP
		end
		selection.frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -docked)
		if selection.frame.Visible then
			docked += Bars.selectionHeight() + GAP
		end
		grid.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -(gridTop + docked))
	end
	selection.frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(layoutBody)
	detail:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(layoutBody)
	layoutBody()

	function skin.layout(showTabs)
		setTabsShown(showTabs)
	end

	panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if not panel.Visible then
			closeMore()
			closeAdd()
		end
	end)

	InventoryPanel.buildDialogs(screenGui, panel, refs)
	return refs
end

function InventoryLayout.build(screenGui)
	if C.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		return InventoryPanel.build(screenGui)
	end
	return buildModern(screenGui)
end

return InventoryLayout

--[[
	InventoryLayout/Bars  -  what docks between the grid and the bottom row of the Inventory in the
	theme modes other than Classic.
	  Bars.buildSelection(content, metrics) -> widgets   the multi-select strip: a count and its actions.
	      { frame, countLbl, editBtn, edit, exportBtn, dissectBtn, deleteBtn, clearBtn }; InventorySelect
	      wires the buttons and shows the strip while tiles are selected. edit: the parts of the
	      Edit button's menu (EditMenu.build).
	  Bars.selectionHeight() -> height of that strip
	  Bars.buildDetail(content, refs, metrics) -> card   details of the selected tile: preview, name
	      and the facts, then one line of actions ending in Insert. Same ref names as the Classic
	      details panel, so the detail modules of InventoryWiring fill and show it unchanged.

function Bars.detailHeight(metrics)
	return metrics.Preview + metrics.ActionRow + DETAIL_PAD * 3
end

-- One "label  value" line of the facts list. valueClass is TextLabel, or TextBox for text the
-- user selects or edits; rightInset keeps room for a control at the line's end.
local function makeFact(facts, metrics, order, labelText, valueClass, rightInset)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Name = labelText .. "Row"
	row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, metrics.FactRow)
	row.LayoutOrder = order
	row.Parent = facts

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Name = "Label"
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = labelText
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	label.Size = UDim2.new(0, metrics.FactLabel, 0, metrics.FactRow)
	TypeScale.style(label, "Label")
	W.paint(label, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	label.Parent = row

	local value = Instance.new(valueClass)
	value.Name = "Value"
	value.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	value.BorderSizePixel = 0
	value.Text = ""
	value.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	value.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
	value.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
	value.Position = UDim2.new(0, metrics.FactLabel, 0, 0)
	value.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(metrics.FactLabel + rightInset), 1, 0)
	TypeScale.style(value, "Value")
	W.paint(value, "TextColor3", "TextLabel")
	if valueClass == "TextBox" then
		value.TextEditable = false
		value.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	end
	value.Parent = row
	return value, label, row
end

-- Name on top (a text box: local entries are renamed in place), then the facts. The detail
-- modules of InventoryWiring relabel the ID and Keywords lines per entry type.

	local name = Instance.new("TextBox")
	name.Name = "Name"
	name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	name.BorderSizePixel = 0
	name.Text = ""
	name.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	name.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd

	local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
	close.Name = "DetailClose"
	close.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	close.Text = "\u{00D7}"
	close.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	close.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)

	TypeScale.style(close, "Glyph")
	W.paint(close, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	close.Parent = column
	refs.InvDetailClose = close

	local facts = Instance.new("Frame")
	facts.Name = "List"
	facts.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	facts.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, nameHeight + NAME_GAP)
	facts.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -(nameHeight + NAME_GAP))
	facts.Parent = column
	W.addListLayout(facts, 0)

	local idRow
	refs.InvDetailID, refs.InvDetailIDLabel, idRow = makeFact(facts, metrics, 1, "ID", "TextBox", metrics.Copy + 4)

	copy.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)

	refs.InvDetailGrid, refs.InvDetailGridLabel, gridRow = makeFact(facts, metrics, 3, "Grid", "TextBox", 0)
	refs.InvDetailGrid.PlaceholderText = "e.g. 8 for 8x8"
	refs.InvDetailGrid.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold

	-- Keywords come last. Only textures have a grid; when the wiring hides that line, this one
	-- (an asset's path can be long) wraps onto the room it leaves.
	local keywordsRow
	refs.InvDetailKeywords, refs.InvDetailKeywordsLabel, keywordsRow = makeFact(facts, metrics, 4, "Keywords", "TextLabel", 0)
	refs.InvDetailKeywords.TextWrapped = true
	local function fitKeywords()
		local gridShown = refs.InvDetailGrid.Visible
		gridRow.Visible = gridShown
		keywordsRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, metrics.FactRow * (gridShown and 1 or 2))

	refs.InvDetailGrid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(fitKeywords)

-- One line under the preview: Favourite, then Trust Asset and Delete when the wiring shows them,
-- and Insert taking the rest of the width as the largest control.
local function buildActions(inner, refs, metrics)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Name = "Actions"
	row.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	refs.InvFavBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, metrics.Favourite, 1, 0)

	W.addCorner(insert)

	flex.FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill
	flex.Parent = insert
	refs.InvInsertBtn = insert

	-- Dark text on a light green, white on a dark one.
	local function paintInsertText()
		local green = T.Green
		local brightness = green.R * 0.299 + green.G * 0.587 + green.B * 0.114
		insert.TextColor3 = brightness > 0.45 and Color3.fromRGB(18, 24, 10) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	end
	paintInsertText()
	table.insert(W.getThemed().repaints, paintInsertText)

function Bars.buildDetail(content, refs, metrics)
	local card = Instance.new("Frame")

--[[
	InventoryLayout/BottomRow  -  the row along the bottom of the Inventory in the theme modes other
	than Classic: a round filter button at the left, the search bar with its result count, and in
	the local lists a round add button at the right.
	  BottomRow.build(content, refs, metrics, skin) -> row, setTabsShown(shown), closeMenus()
	Filter button: opens a popover holding the filter tabs (All / Static / Flipbook / Favs / Recent,
	hidden through setTabsShown for lists without them) over the option list InventoryWiring fills
	and shows. The popover follows that list's Visible.
	Add button (refs.InvToolbar, shown by the wiring in local lists): its menu holds Import
	Selected, the import options, Upload and Dissect; the wiring shows the ones a list has.
	Both open upward and are children of their button, so they follow it when the row reflows.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Parent.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local GAP = 8
local MENU_Z = 20
-- Gap between a round button and the popover above it.
local POPOVER_LIFT = 6
-- Bars of the filter icon, widest first.
local FILTER_BARS = { 12, 8, 4 }

local BottomRow = {}

local function makeCircle(row, name, size, order)
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Name = name
	button.Text = ""
	button.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
	button.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
	button.BorderSizePixel = 0
	button.Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size)
	button.LayoutOrder = order
	button.Parent = row
	W.addCorner(button, UDim.new(1, 0))
	W.addStroke(button)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().blobs, button)
	W.wireFieldStates(button)
	return button
end

local function buildFilter(row, refs, metrics, skin)
	local button = makeCircle(row, "FilterBtn", metrics.Circle, 1)
	refs.InvFilterBtn = button

	-- Three bars narrowing downward, drawn: the plugin has no icon images.
	local lines = {}
	for index, width in ipairs(FILTER_BARS) do
		local line = Instance.new("Frame")
		line.Name = "Bar" .. index
		line.BorderSizePixel = 0
		line.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		line.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, (index - 2) * 4)
		line.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, 2)
		line.Parent = button
		W.addCorner(line, UDim.new(1, 0))
		lines[index] = line
	end
	skin.setFilterButton(button, lines)

	local popover = W.makeMenu(button, "FilterPopover", metrics.FilterMenu)
	popover.Active = true
	popover.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	popover.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -POPOVER_LIFT)
	popover.ZIndex = MENU_Z

	local tabs = Instance.new("Frame")
	tabs.Name = "Tabs"
	tabs.BorderSizePixel = 0
	tabs.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, metrics.TabRow)
	tabs.LayoutOrder = 0
	W.paint(tabs, "BackgroundColor3", "Panel")
	tabs.Parent = popover
	W.addCorner(tabs)
	W.addPadding(tabs, 2, 2, 2, 2)
	W.addListLayout(tabs, 2, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	refs.TabAll = skin.addTab(tabs, "TabAll", "All", 0)
	refs.TabStatic = skin.addTab(tabs, "TabStatic", "Static", 1)
	refs.TabFlipbook = skin.addTab(tabs, "TabFlipbook", "Flipbook", 2)
	refs.TabFavourites = skin.addTab(tabs, "TabFavourites", "\u{2605} Favs", 3)
	refs.TabRecents = skin.addTab(tabs, "TabRecents", "Recent", 4)
	skin.setActiveTab(refs.TabAll)

	-- As tall as its options up to metrics.MenuMax, then it scrolls.
	local options = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	options.Name = "FilterDropdown"
	options.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	options.BorderSizePixel = 0
	options.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	options.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	options.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	options.ScrollBarThickness = 3
	options.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	options.LayoutOrder = 1
	options.Visible = false
	options.Parent = popover
	W.addListLayout(options, 2)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().scrollbars, options)
	refs.InvFilterDropdown = options

	local optionStep = LAYOUT.Row - 4 + 2
	local function fitToOptions()
		local count = 0
		for _, child in ipairs(options:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextButton") then
				count += 1
			end
		end
		options.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.min(count * optionStep, metrics.MenuMax))
	end
	options.ChildAdded:Connect(fitToOptions)
	options.ChildRemoved:Connect(fitToOptions)
	options:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		popover.Visible = options.Visible
	end)

	return function(shown)
		tabs.Visible = shown
	end
end

local function buildSearch(row, refs, metrics)
	local box, field = W.makeSearchField(row, "Search", "Search...")
	field.Name = "Search"
	field.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, LAYOUT.Search)
	field.LayoutOrder = 2
	box.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(LAYOUT.FieldPad * 2 + metrics.SearchCount), 1, 0)
	local flex = Instance.new("UIFlexItem")
	flex.FlexMode = Enum.UIFlexMode.Fill
	flex.Parent = field
	refs.InvSearch = box

	local count = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	count.Name = "ResultCount"
	count.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	count.Text = ""
	count.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	count.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	count.Position = UDim2.new(1, -LAYOUT.FieldPad, 0, 0)
	count.Size = UDim2.new(0, metrics.SearchCount, 1, 0)
	TypeScale.style(count, "Caption")
	W.paint(count, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	count.Parent = field
	refs.InvResultCount = count
end

local function buildAdd(row, refs, metrics)
	local button = makeCircle(row, "Toolbar", metrics.Circle, 3)
	button.Text = "+"
	button.Visible = false
	TypeScale.style(button, "Group")
	W.paint(button, "TextColor3", "TextHeading")
	refs.InvToolbar = button

	local menu = W.makeMenu(button, "AddMenu", metrics.AddMenu)
	menu.Active = true
	menu.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
	menu.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, -POPOVER_LIFT)
	menu.ZIndex = MENU_Z

	refs.InvToolImport = W.makeMenuItem(menu, "Import", "Import Selected", 0)
	refs.InvImportArrow = W.makeMenuItem(menu, "ImportArrow", "Import options \u{25BC}", 1)

	-- Opened by the item above (InventoryWiring toggles its Visible); the options tick in place.
	local options = Instance.new("Frame")
	options.Name = "ImportDropdown"
	options.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	options.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	options.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	options.LayoutOrder = 2
	options.Visible = false
	options.Parent = menu
	W.addListLayout(options, 2)
	W.addPadding(options, 12, 0, 0, 0)
	refs.InvImportDropdown = options
	refs.InvOptBundle = W.makeMenuItem(options, "Bundle", "\u{2610} Bundle (import as one)", 0)
	refs.InvOptPaths = W.makeMenuItem(options, "Paths", "\u{2610} Paths (save locations)", 1)

	refs.InvToolUpload = W.makeMenuItem(menu, "Upload", "Upload", 3)
	refs.InvToolDissect = W.makeMenuItem(menu, "Dissect", "Dissect", 4)

	button.Activated:Connect(function()
		menu.Visible = not menu.Visible
	end)
	local function close()
		menu.Visible = false
	end
	-- An action closes the menu; the wiring's own handlers do the work.
	for _, action in ipairs({ refs.InvToolImport, refs.InvToolUpload, refs.InvToolDissect }) do
		action.Activated:Connect(close)
	end
	return close
end

function BottomRow.build(content, refs, metrics, skin)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Name = "BottomRow"
	row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	row.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
	row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Search)
	-- Its popovers open upward over the grid and whatever is docked above the row.
	row.ZIndex = 10
	row.Parent = content
	local list = W.addListLayout(row, GAP, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)
	list.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center

	local setTabsShown = buildFilter(row, refs, metrics, skin)
	buildSearch(row, refs, metrics)
	local closeAdd = buildAdd(row, refs, metrics)
	return row, setTabsShown, closeAdd
end

return BottomRow

--[[
	InventoryLayout/EditMenu  -  the menu of the Edit button on the Inventory's multi-select
	strip, the same in every theme mode: what is changed on all selected local textures at once.
	  EditMenu.build(button, host, width, opensUp) -> parts
	      parts.menu                              hidden; the wiring shows it
	      parts.place()                           puts the menu at the button; called on opening
	      parts.gridBox                           a Grid for every selected texture, set on Enter
	      parts.list                              holds one row per custom filter
	      parts.makeRow(name, text, order) -> TextButton     a row of the list
	  EditMenu.makeInput(row, placeholder) -> TextBox     laid over a menu row, hidden until shown:
	                                                      a new filter's name, or a rename
	  EditMenu.addRowTools(row) -> rename, remove         "Rename" and "Delete" at the row's right
	                                                      end; the row's own text stops before them
	The menu is a child of `host` (the strip, or the panel in Classic), never of the button: a
	button as wide as its text grows to hold whatever is inside it. It opens over the grid: above
	the button where the strip docks at the bottom of the panel, below it in Classic, where the
	strip is at the top.
	InventoryWiring/InventoryEdit wires the parts; InventoryWiring/InventoryFilters uses the two
	row helpers on the Filters menu's own rows, in every mode.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Parent.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T
local LAYOUT = C.LAYOUT

local MENU_Z = 30
-- Gap between the button and its menu.
local LIFT = 6
local GRID_LABEL = 40
local CAPTION_HEIGHT = 16
-- Rows shown before the list scrolls.
local MAX_ROWS = 6
-- A row tool's width, room for "Delete?": in text sizes, and in Classic, whose captions
-- keep one small size, in pixels.
local TOOL_WIDTH = 3.5
local TOOL_WIDTH_CLASSIC = 40
local TOOL_GAP = 2
local TOOL_MARGIN = 4

local EditMenu = {}

function EditMenu.makeInput(row, placeholder)
	local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
	box.Name = "Input"
	box.BorderSizePixel = 0
	box.Text = ""
	box.PlaceholderText = placeholder
	box.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold
	box.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	box.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	box.ZIndex = row.ZIndex + 2
	box.Visible = false
	TypeScale.style(box, "Label")
	W.paint(box, "BackgroundColor3", "Sunken")
	W.paint(box, "TextColor3", "TextPrimary")
	box.Parent = row
	W.addCorner(box)
	return box
end

function EditMenu.addRowTools(row)
	local toolWidth = C.MODE.Structure.Classic and TOOL_WIDTH_CLASSIC or math.floor(T.TextSize * TOOL_WIDTH)
	local width = toolWidth * 2 + TOOL_GAP

	-- The row's padding keeps its text clear of the tools, which sit in that padding.
	local padding = row:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
	if not padding then
		padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
		padding.Parent = row
	end
	padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, width + TOOL_MARGIN * 2)

	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Name = "Tools"
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
	holder.Position = UDim2.new(1, width + TOOL_MARGIN, 0, 0)
	holder.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 1, 0)
	holder.ZIndex = row.ZIndex + 1
	holder.Parent = row
	W.addListLayout(holder, TOOL_GAP, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal)

	local function makeTool(name, text, order, role)
		local tool = Instance.new("TextButton")
		tool.Name = name
		tool.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		tool.BorderSizePixel = 0
		tool.Text = text
		tool.Size = UDim2.new(0, toolWidth, 1, 0)
		tool.LayoutOrder = order
		tool.ZIndex = holder.ZIndex
		TypeScale.style(tool, "Caption")
		W.paint(tool, "TextColor3", role)
		tool.Parent = holder
		return tool
	end
	return makeTool("Rename", "Rename", 1, "TextSecondary"), makeTool("Remove", "Delete", 2, "Red")
end

function EditMenu.build(button, host, width, opensUp)
	local rowHeight = LAYOUT.Row - 4
	local rowStep = rowHeight + 2

	local menu = W.makeMenu(host, "EditMenu", width)
	menu.Active = true
	menu.ZIndex = MENU_Z
	menu.AnchorPoint = opensUp and Vector2.new(0, 1) or Vector2.new(1, 0)

	local gridBox, gridRow = W.makeNumberRow(menu, "Grid", "Grid", "", GRID_LABEL, 0)
	gridBox.PlaceholderText = "4 for 4x4, 0 for none"
	gridBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	gridRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, LAYOUT.Row)

	W.makeDivider(menu, 1)

	local caption = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	caption.Name = "FiltersCaption"
	caption.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	caption.Text = "In filters"
	caption.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	caption.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, CAPTION_HEIGHT)
	caption.LayoutOrder = 2
	TypeScale.style(caption, "Caption")
	W.paint(caption, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
	caption.Parent = menu
	W.addPadding(caption, 8, 8, 0, 0)

	local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	list.Name = "Filters"
	list.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	list.BorderSizePixel = 0
	list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	list.ScrollBarThickness = 3
	list.ScrollBarImageColor3 = T.ScrollBar
	list.LayoutOrder = 3
	list.Parent = menu
	W.addListLayout(list, 2)
	table.insert(W.getThemed().scrollbars, list)

	local function fitToRows()
		local count = 0
		for _, child in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("TextButton") then
				count += 1
			end
		end
		list.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.min(count, MAX_ROWS) * rowStep)
	end
	list.ChildAdded:Connect(fitToRows)
	list.ChildRemoved:Connect(fitToRows)

	local parts = { menu = menu, gridBox = gridBox, list = list }

	-- Above the button with its left edge on the button's, or below it with its right edge on
	-- the button's. In shares of the host, so no UIScale enters.
	function parts.place()
		local hostSize = host.AbsoluteSize
		if hostSize.X <= 0 or hostSize.Y <= 0 then
			return
		end
		local corner = button.AbsolutePosition - host.AbsolutePosition
		local left = corner.X / hostSize.X
		local top = corner.Y / hostSize.Y
		if opensUp then
			menu.Position = UDim2.new(left, 0, top, -LIFT)
		else
			local right = left + button.AbsoluteSize.X / hostSize.X
			local bottom = top + button.AbsoluteSize.Y / hostSize.Y
			menu.Position = UDim2.new(right, 0, bottom, LIFT)
		end
	end

	function parts.makeRow(name, text, order)
		local row = W.makeMenuItem(list, name, text, order)
		row.ZIndex = MENU_Z + 1
		return row
	end

	return parts
end

return EditMenu

--[[
	InventoryLayout/Skin  -  the parts of the Inventory that InventoryWiring creates and repaints
	at run time, in the theme modes other than Classic: grid tiles, the list tabs, filter tab and
	menu-option states.
	  Skin.new(metrics) -> skin, published as refs.InvSkin. Classic publishes none and the wiring
	  keeps its own original code for each of these.
	    skin.metrics                              Metrics.get()
	    skin.makeCell(grid, index) -> cell        the parts Grid.luau pools: wrapper, img, nameLabel,
	                                              highlight, quickInsert, favStar, typeBadge
	    skin.setCellHover(cell, hovered)
	    skin.setCellBadge(cell, entry)            a flipbook texture shows its grid; nothing else is badged
	    skin.buildLists(groups, onPick)           groups = { { title, modes = { { id, text }, ... } }, ... }.
	                                              One switch segment per group and one tab per list; a
	                                              click calls onPick(id). Picking a group picks the list
	                                              of the same name in it, or its first.
	    skin.setActiveList(id)
	    skin.addTab(parent, name, text, order) -> button   a filter tab (All, Static, ...)
	    skin.setActiveTab(button)
	    skin.makeMenuOption(menu, name, order) -> button
	    skin.setOptionActive(button, label, on)
	  Assigned by InventoryLayout: skin.layout(showTabs), skin.selection (the multi-select strip),
	  and the hosts through skin.setListHosts / skin.setFilterButton.
	Active states are kept here and repainted after a theme change.
]]

local C = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants)
local W = require(script.Parent.Parent.Widgets)
local TypeScale = require(script.Parent.Parent.TypeScale)
local T = C.T

local RING = 2
local QUICK = 20
local BADGE_HEIGHT = 16
local ALL_TAB = "TabAll"

local Skin = {}

function Skin.new(metrics)
	local skin = { metrics = metrics }

	local tabs = {}
	local activeTab = nil
	local groupHost = nil
	local listHost = nil
	local groups = {}
	local groupButtons = {}
	local listButtons = {}
	local activeList = nil
	local filterButton = nil
	local filterLines = {}
	-- Option button -> whether it is ticked. Weak keys: the wiring destroys options on every rebuild.
	local optionOn = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

	local function groupOf(listId)
		for index, group in ipairs(groups) do
			for _, pair in ipairs(group.modes) do
				if pair[1] == listId then
					return index, pair[2]
				end
			end
		end
		return nil, nil
	end

	local function paintLists()
		local activeGroup = groupOf(activeList)
		for index, button in pairs(groupButtons) do
			W.paintSegment(button, index == activeGroup)
		end
		for listId, button in pairs(listButtons) do
			button.Visible = groupOf(listId) == activeGroup
			W.paintSegment(button, listId == activeList)
		end
	end

	-- The filter button is filled while a tab other than All or any option narrows the list.
	local function paintFilterButton()
		if not filterButton then
			return
		end
		local filtering = activeTab ~= nil and activeTab.Name ~= ALL_TAB
		for option, on in pairs(optionOn) do
			if on and option.Parent and option.Name ~= "All" then
				filtering = true
			end
		end
		filterButton.BackgroundColor3 = filtering and T.Accent or T.BlobBg
		for _, line in ipairs(filterLines) do
			line.BackgroundColor3 = filtering and T.OnAccent or T.MutedGold
		end
	end

	local function paintTabs()
		for _, tab in ipairs(tabs) do
			W.paintSegment(tab, tab == activeTab)
		end
		paintFilterButton()
	end

	-- Segments repaint themselves after a theme change (WidgetSegments); the filter button is ours.
	table.insert(W.getThemed().repaints, paintFilterButton)

	function skin.setListHosts(groupFrame, listFrame)
		groupHost = groupFrame
		listHost = listFrame
	end

	function skin.setFilterButton(button, lines)
		filterButton = button
		filterLines = lines
		paintFilterButton()
	end

	function skin.addTab(parent, name, text, order)
		local tab = W.makeSegment(parent, name, text, order, { fill = true })
		table.insert(tabs, tab)
		return tab
	end

	function skin.setActiveTab(button)
		activeTab = button
		paintTabs()
	end

	function skin.buildLists(groupList, onPick)
		for _, button in pairs(groupButtons) do
			button:Destroy()
		end
		for _, button in pairs(listButtons) do
			button:Destroy()
		end
		groups = groupList
		groupButtons = {}
		listButtons = {}

		local listOrder = 0
		for groupIndex, group in ipairs(groups) do
			local segment = W.makeSegment(groupHost, group.title, group.title, groupIndex)
			groupButtons[groupIndex] = segment
			segment.Activated:Connect(function()
				local activeGroup, activeText = groupOf(activeList)
				if activeGroup == groupIndex then
					return
				end
				local target = group.modes[1][1]
				for _, pair in ipairs(group.modes) do
					if pair[2] == activeText then
						target = pair[1]
					end
				end
				onPick(target)
			end)

			for _, pair in ipairs(group.modes) do
				local listId = pair[1]
				listOrder += 1
				local tab = W.makeSegment(listHost, listId, pair[2], listOrder, { fill = true })
				listButtons[listId] = tab
				tab.Activated:Connect(function()
					onPick(listId)
				end)
			end
		end
		paintLists()
	end

	function skin.setActiveList(listId)
		activeList = listId
		paintLists()
	end

	function skin.makeMenuOption(menu, name, order)
		return W.makeMenuItem(menu, name, name, order)
	end

	function skin.setOptionActive(button, label, on)
		button.Text = on and (label .. "  \u{2713}") or label
		button.TextColor3 = on and T.BrightGold or T.MutedGold
		optionOn[button] = on
		paintFilterButton()
	end

	-- One grid tile. The backing and the image are separate: InventoryWiring clears the image's own
	-- background and puts a 3D viewport between the two for assets and mesh frames.
	function skin.makeCell(grid, index)
		local tile = metrics.Tile
		local corner = UDim.new(0, metrics.TileCorner)

		local wrapper = Instance.new("Frame")
		wrapper.Name = "TW" .. index
		wrapper.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		wrapper.Size = UDim2.new(0, tile + metrics.TileGap, 0, tile + metrics.TileName + metrics.TileGap)
		wrapper.Parent = grid

		local backing = Instance.new("Frame")
		backing.Name = "Tile"
		backing.BorderSizePixel = 0
		backing.Size = UDim2.new(0, tile, 0, tile)
		backing.ZIndex = 0
		W.paint(backing, "BackgroundColor3", "Sunken")
		backing.Parent = wrapper
		W.addCorner(backing, corner)
		local outline = W.addStroke(backing)

		local image = Instance.new("ImageButton")
		image.Name = "Thumb"
		image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		image.BorderSizePixel = 0
		image.Size = UDim2.new(0, tile, 0, tile)
		image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
		image.Parent = wrapper
		W.addCorner(image, corner)

		local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
		ring.Name = "HL"
		ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		ring.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		ring.ZIndex = 2
		ring.Visible = false
		ring.Parent = image
		W.addCorner(ring, corner)
		local ringStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		ringStroke.Thickness = RING
		ringStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
		W.paint(ringStroke, "Color", "Focus")
		ringStroke.Parent = ring

		local star = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		star.Name = "Fav"
		star.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		star.Text = "\u{2605}"
		star.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
		star.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 3)
		star.ZIndex = 3
		star.Visible = false
		TypeScale.style(star, "Caption")
		W.paint(star, "TextColor3", "Focus")
		star.Parent = image

		local quick = Instance.new("TextButton")
		quick.Name = "QI"
		quick.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
		quick.BorderSizePixel = 0
		quick.Text = "+"
		quick.Size = UDim2.new(0, QUICK, 0, QUICK)
		quick.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(QUICK + 4), 1, -(QUICK + 4))
		quick.ZIndex = 3
		quick.Visible = false
		TypeScale.style(quick, "Button")
		W.paint(quick, "TextColor3", "TextHeading")
		quick.Parent = image
		W.addCorner(quick, UDim.new(1, 0))
		W.addStroke(quick)
		table.insert(W.getThemed().blobs, quick)

		local badge = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		badge.Name = "TypeBadge"
		badge.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
		badge.BorderSizePixel = 0
		badge.Text = ""
		badge.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
		badge.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, BADGE_HEIGHT)
		badge.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, -(BADGE_HEIGHT + 4))
		badge.ZIndex = 3
		badge.Visible = false
		TypeScale.style(badge, "Caption")
		W.paint(badge, "BackgroundColor3", "Panel")
		W.paint(badge, "TextColor3", "TextLabel")
		badge.Parent = image
		W.addCorner(badge, UDim.new(0, 4))
		W.addPadding(badge, 5, 5, 0, 0)

		-- Always present: the wiring writes the entry's name here and the tooltip reads it back.
		local name = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		name.Name = "Name"
		name.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		name.Text = ""
		name.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		name.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
		name.Size = UDim2.new(0, tile, 0, metrics.TileName)
		name.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, tile + 2)
		name.Visible = metrics.TileName > 0
		TypeScale.style(name, "Caption")
		W.paint(name, "TextColor3", "TextSecondary")
		name.Parent = wrapper

		return {
			wrapper = wrapper, img = image, nameLabel = name, highlight = ring,
			quickInsert = quick, favStar = star, typeBadge = badge, outline = outline,
		}
	end

	function skin.setCellHover(cell, hovered)
		cell.outline.Color = hovered and T.OutlineHover or T.Border
	end

	function skin.setCellBadge(cell, entry)
		local grid = entry.grid
		local isSheet = entry._type == nil and grid ~= nil and grid > 1
		cell.typeBadge.Visible = isSheet
		if isSheet then
			cell.typeBadge.Text = grid .. "\u{00D7}" .. grid
		end
	end

	return skin
end

return Skin
